description: This file defines the ReadableShopOrder class, which extends ReadableOrder and implements Serializable. It includes fields and methods related to order details such as shipping summary, error message, subtotals, and grand total, serving as a data transfer object for order information in a web application.

classes.name: ReadableShopOrder
classes.description: A serializable class representing a view of an order with shipping summary, totals, and error information, extending the ReadableOrder base class.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the global error message associated with the order.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the global error message for the order.

methods.name: getGrandTotal
methods.description: Retrieves the grand total amount of the order.

methods.name: setGrandTotal
methods.description: Sets the grand total amount for the order.

methods.name: getSubTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of subtotal details for the order.

methods.name: setSubTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of subtotal details for the order.
